# Paid Public Entry-Mode Views

Captured from parent `af33d5d` plus the exact Suncleanser/attached product patch
`0b4e743b2bb3a54e1d5810f9692ceacc6a8829f972439cca385b362af7f8d8da`.
The generator verified all original canonical facts against their provenance,
performed real paid Suncleanser casts for both seats and both modes, and used
the existing public serializer/legal-move generator without mutating the root.
It then chose each offered mode, selected the actual target, resumed resolution,
and checked the corresponding creature/player counters were removed.

Native SQL, socket and child attempts were denied before backend imports.
The snapshots are actor-visible public outputs, not fabricated card positions,
HTTP responses or injected stack frames. The frontend test additionally narrows
the offered list to one option as a labeled protocol-only boundary. It does not
claim that narrowing as a new paid backend scenario or browser qualification.
